title: Conducting Approval Interviews
summary: How to plan and conduct interviews with proposed directors and key function holders that test competence and understanding rather than recitation.
contentGaps: Written as part of a programme: Aim and Purpose is the module's one-line description; audience, prior knowledge and core reading come from the programme

sections.Aim and Purpose: How to plan and conduct interviews with proposed directors and key function holders that test competence and understanding rather than recitation.
Learning Objectives: Plan an approval interview with clear objectives and lines of questioning
Use open and probing questions to test knowledge and judgement
Record the interview and its conclusions as evidence
Syllabus: Preparing the interview plan from the application file
Scenario-based and probing questions for different roles
Assessing answers: depth, ownership and red flags
Role-play: interviewing a proposed chief executive and compliance officer
Intended Audience: Authorisation and licensing staff responsible for approving owners, directors and key function holders
Supervisors and inspectors who assess changes in control or monitor ongoing fitness
Enforcement and legal staff involved in fitness-related decisions and challenges
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: Some experience of authorisation, licensing or supervisory work is helpful. Participants new to the gateway may benefit from attending a foundation programme first.
Core Reading: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (2024), Core Principles for Effective Banking Supervision
IAIS (2019, as updated), Insurance Core Principles and Common Framework for the Supervision of Internationally Active Insurance Groups
IOSCO (2017), Objectives and Principles of Securities Regulation
FATF (2023), Guidance on Beneficial Ownership of Legal Persons
